spatial_model.description: Structural spherical-head HRTF: head-shadow one-pole/one-zero filter, Woodworth-style ITD, tempered pinna-echo model, diffuse-field equalised. Computed at run time; no measured data is bundled.
spatial_model.reference: C. P. Brown and R. O. Duda, 'A structural model for binaural sound synthesis', IEEE Trans. Speech and Audio Processing 6(5), 1998.
spatial_model.coordinate_convention: azimuth clockwise from front (right positive), elevation up positive, listener-centred
spatial_model.normalisation: diffuse-field EQ (cos-elevation weighted, 1/3-octave smoothed, ±10 dB) plus the K-weighted loudness convention in docs/dsp-math.md
spatial_model.license: Original implementation, part of Aether by Ambarish Mallick. No third-party dataset; no redistribution restrictions from measured data.
